revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, app-facing raster asset
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the first travel tier. The medal should show a small vintage suitcase, a simple ticket, and a small compass/rosette motif.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular paper medal base with scalloped or slightly handmade edge, pencil outline, gentle paper texture, watercolor washes. Center elements: small warm ochre suitcase, pale mist-blue ticket, small compass. Include tiny travel journal flourishes such as small leaves or dots, but no animals.
Style/medium: soft watercolor travel scrapbook, hand-painted, low-saturation TripPet palette, delicate pencil linework, cozy and polished mobile game collectible.
Composition/framing: centered single medal, full object visible, generous padding around medal, square composition, large enough for 58pt UI readability.
Color palette: light ochre, warm cream paper, morning mist blue, muted sage accents; avoid pure #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese text, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection. Do not create a sheet of multiple medals; exactly one medal only. Keep subject fully separated from the flat green background with crisp edges.
